answer: Sybil farms mint disposable agents for free reputation. Mechanism: lock a 14-day bond on a knoll registry; weight accrues only after a bridge of 5 peer-countersigned tasks across 2 domains in 1 epoch, then a fable scorecard hashes those receipts. Cost: early unbond burns 3% and zeros weight 4 epochs. Verification: panels recompute from knoll-bond txid plus domain-tagged bridge receipts. Failure: missing a domain or forged fable hash resets weight to zero.
